questions.prompt: What configuration language does Terraform use?
questions.explanation: Terraform configurations are written in HashiCorp Configuration Language (HCL).

questions.prompt: Which command initializes a Terraform working directory?
questions.explanation: terraform init downloads providers and prepares the working directory.

questions.prompt: Which file tracks the resources Terraform has created?
questions.explanation: terraform.tfstate is Terraform's source of truth for existing infrastructure.
